correctness.rationale: Defect q admits five exhaustive disjoint cases. Direct case inequalities make Phi nonincreasing under every legal move; the mandatory two-pebble predecessor supplies necessity. Constructive local extraction exactly realizes Phi at the hub when Phi>=1. An explicit perturbation clears all Phi=3 states except the pure central three-stack. Defect-sum algebra proves sharp 4m and the unique critical obstruction orbit, with 2m labelled instances. Independently enumerated labelled graphs through three blades and sizes up to 12 agree with every criterion prediction. No inference from finite tests to infinite theorem is used.

value.rationale: A sharp O(m) test for all configurations, a new exact threshold for a natural noncomplete-multipartite graph family, and an exact single-orbit classification with 2m labelled extremal obstructions go substantially beyond routine upper-bound substitution. The five-state defect offers reusable structural insight for pebbling on block graphs, without claiming unproved generalizations.
